thread:
ellie: Kicking off co-marketing prep with NebulaNest for their marketplace listing + joint webinar. Goals: PR leads, demo funnel, 1 blog post + benchmark. Draft plan below. Please flag owners.

sam: timeline?

ellie: timeline: webinar 2026-03-10, blog 2026-03-03, marketplace promo 2026-03-05. rehearsal 2026-03-08.

jorge: confirmed with NebulaNest — they can commit 2 speakers and 1 customer case study. They want a short benchmark we can publish with permission.

tara: routing note — All webinar signups should create SFDC campaign 'NN-Webinar-Mar26' and route to AE queue 'nebula-nest' + tag 'co-marketing'. Can ops add automation?

sam: utm params suggestion: utm_source=nebula-nest&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=nn_webinar_mar26

liam: need speaker headshots, bios, and logo SVGs. prefer 900x300 for hero banners, 1080x1080 for social cards.

ellie: promo copy draft: "Join Redwood + NebulaNest for a hands-on demo: inference orchestration that reduces per-token cost by ~40% and keeps p95 latency steady. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=nebula-nest&utm_campaign=nn_webinar_mar26" feedback?

jorge: tweak copy — good, but remove approximate percent in headline. Use the percent in the supporting paragraph. Partners want conservative claims.

ellie: updated headline: "See how inference orchestration lowers cost and stabilizes latency". supporting line includes the ~40% note.

dev-bot: Reminder: submit speaker recording consent forms: https://forms.redwood/consent (auto-reminder set for invited speakers).

tara: Sales follow-up playbook: cadence = 1) registration thank you email 2) 48h reminder 3) day-of 30m 4) post-webinar recording + CTA to 'request a demo'. I'll draft full playbook in Notion: https://notion.redwood/inbound-playbooks/nebula-nest

sam: benchmark narrative: run A/B on our batching+KV cache vs NebulaNest baseline. headline chart = cost/token (y-axis) and p95 latency (y2) across request sizes. Jorge -> can Nebula share a 3-week trace sample?

jorge: yes, will get legal to sign a narrow NDA for logs. ETA EOD tomorrow. Customer case study contact is @maria at Nebula — she confirmed.

liam: creative timeline: hero banner by 2026-03-01, social cards by 2026-03-03. I'll upload source files and sizes to #assets.

ellie: decision: webinar platform — Zoom (licensed) to capture cloud recording into our account. Any objections?

tara: Zoom is fine. Set host as marketing@redwood.ai and co-host jorge@redwood.ai. Also enable registration questions: company, role, #employees.

ellie: owners: sam = promo copy + newsletter, liam = creative + assets, jorge = partner logistics + speaker coord, tara = sales routing + follow-ups, ellie = program owner + rehearsal scheduling.

sam: I'll draft a 3-email promo cadence and 5 subject line variants. Posting drafts tomorrow.

liam: uploading first-pass hero mock in #assets in 15m :thumbsup:

ellie: small PR ask — can comms craft an op-ed angle oriented at infra engineers about inference economics? @mara?

mike: I'll review the benchmark numbers and help craft the chart captions.

alexa: PMM sanity-checks OK — send the draft benchmark and we'll validate wording.

ellie: one last ops thing: add UTM for partner links + tracking sheet. I'll create a shared sheet and invite sales/partner ops.

jorge: confirming NebulaNest will cross-promote on their newsletter and partner marketplace spotlight. They asked for a co-branded banner 1200x400 for their listing.

ellie: thanks. checklist posted in Notion + rehearsal invite sent for 2026-03-08 10:00 PT. Please RSVP. :rocket:
